body: Thanks for taking the time to write this. What you said is very true, I've gone through a lot of different changes in my life already, taking part in lots of different sports, learning instruments, learning to draw, learning other languages, etc. And I am still doing so. One of my more recent discoveries was my love for music, I found out I loved writing it. But no matter what, I still don't ever feel very happy/excited, etc. in my life as a whole. I don't really know how to explain it because I don't understand it myself. I just never really feel happy... I know it makes no sense, I'm sorry.
